items.html: Behold, it has been explained how, through the milk, the Mochin of Hochma was repaired in its thirty-two paths, and therefore the thirty-two teeth grew. And it is also known that the gums, in which the thirty-two teeth grow, are the aspect of Hochma. For so are the letters of 'Hochma' (Chet-Kaf-Mem-Hei): 'Chech MA', meaning the palate of ZA, which is called MA. Therefore the thirty-two teeth, which are drawn from the thirty-two paths of Hochma, are rooted in the gums, which are the aspect of Hochma.
